001package com.streamconverter;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004
005/**
006 * Indicates an internal system failure (notification class A in the exception policy): failures
007 * that require administrator intervention and are caused by bugs or configuration errors in the
008 * application itself.
009 *
010 * <p>This exception is used for unexpected failures within the StreamConverter library or the
011 * application using it. Examples include:
012 *
013 * <ul>
014 *   <li>Unexpected runtime exceptions during stream processing
015 *   <li>Resource (stream, connection) failure to close
016 *   <li>Pipeline orchestration failure
017 *   <li>Configuration error in the application's setup
018 * </ul>
019 *
020 * <p>The default user-facing message advises the user to contact an administrator:
021 *
022 * <pre>{@code
023 * "システムエラーが発生しました。管理者にお問い合わせください。"
024 * }</pre>
025 *
026 * <p>Extends {@link StreamProcessingException}, and therefore {@link IOException}, so that callers
027 * of {@link com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand#execute} can handle all stream-level
028 * failures with a single {@code catch (IOException)} block.
029 *
030 * <p>See docs/reference/EXCEPTION_POLICY.md for the full exception classification policy.
031 *
032 * @see StreamProcessingException
033 * @see UserInputException
034 * @see ExternalTransientException
035 * @see ExternalPermanentException
036 */
037public final class InternalSystemException extends StreamProcessingException {
038  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
039
040  /**
041   * Default user-facing message for internal system failures. Advises users to contact an
042   * administrator.
043   */
044  public static final String DEFAULT_USER_MESSAGE = "システムエラーが発生しました。管理者にお問い合わせください。";
045
046  /**
047   * Constructs a new InternalSystemException with the specified detail message.
048   *
049   * @param message the detail message (developer-facing, for logging)
050   */
051  public InternalSystemException(String message) {
052    super(message);
053  }
054
055  /**
056   * Constructs a new InternalSystemException with the specified detail message and cause.
057   *
058   * @param message the detail message (developer-facing, for logging)
059   * @param cause the underlying cause
060   */
061  public InternalSystemException(String message, Throwable cause) {
062    super(message, cause);
063  }
064
065  /**
066   * Constructs a new InternalSystemException with the specified cause.
067   *
068   * @param cause the underlying cause
069   */
070  public InternalSystemException(Throwable cause) {
071    super(cause);
072  }
073
074  /**
075   * Returns the default user-facing message for internal system failures.
076   *
077   * <p>This message is suitable for display to end users, advising them to contact an
078   * administrator.
079   *
080   * @return the default internal system failure message
081   */
082  @Override
083  public String getUserMessage() {
084    return DEFAULT_USER_MESSAGE;
085  }
086}
